name: DecisionMind AI - Generate and Email Team Report

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Get Opinions
nodes.notes: Select your Google Sheets credential and replace the spreadsheet ID. This reads rows from the Opinions tab; the Code node filters them by DecisionID.

nodes.name: Code - Prepare Team Data
nodes.notes: Your Opinions sheet must include DecisionID, Problem, MemberName, Role, PreferredAlternative, Reasoning, Concerns, Confidence, and Email columns.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Gemini Analysis
nodes.notes: Create an n8n Header Auth credential with header name x-goog-api-key and your Gemini API key as the value. Do not paste the API key into this workflow JSON.

nodes.name: Convert to File - Report TXT
nodes.notes: Creates a text report attachment. This is the simplest importable version; PDF conversion can be added later.

parameters.subject: DecisionMind AI - Team Decision Report
parameters.text:
Hello Team,

Please find attached the DecisionMind AI team decision report. It summarizes the submitted viewpoints, disagreements, risks, and suggested next steps.

Please review it together and make the final decision as a team.

Regards,
DecisionMind AI

nodes.name: Send Email - Report to Team
nodes.notes: Configure SMTP credentials and replace YOUR_VERIFIED_SENDER_EMAIL. The workflow sends one email to the unique email addresses found in the matching decision rows.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: 'Team report generated and email delivery requested.', decisionId: $('Code - Extract Report').first().json.decisionId } }}
